text:
alex-marketing: Quick audit — spotted overlap between paid-acq cohort and webinar invite cadence after the last launch. Pasting notes and proposed rule changes here. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X_launch_nurture_audit
meera-growth: Ugh yes i noticed higher unsub rates when users get welcome + webinar on the same day. Which segments are colliding?
chris-analytics: Pulling the last 2 weeks now. Topline: ~14% of Paid Cohort A received both the 3-day welcome and the 5-day webinar invite within a 24h window. Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT user_id, cohort, received_email, sent_at
FROM email_events
WHERE campaign IN ('welcome_v2','webinar_invite_v1')
AND sent_at >= '2026-03-01'
ORDER BY sent_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
tess-campaigns: Thanks. Proposal: shift webinar invite to +8 days for all paid-acq buckets, keep organic at +5. Also add suppression: do not send webinar_invite if user opened any email or triggered onboarding event in last 48h.
sam-sales: That sounds good. For demo-bookers we should always push 1:1 before the webinar invite — don't want dual outreach. Can we add a filter: sales_contacted != true?
alex-marketing: Agree. New rules to implement: 1) paid_acq => webinar_delay = 8d 2) organic => webinar_delay = 5d 3) suppression if last_email_open < 48h OR onboarding_event in 48h 4) exclude users with sales_contacted = true
meera-growth: Quick A/B idea: test +8 vs +11 for paid cohort to see engagement lift. Keep a 10% holdout in each. Measure: open rate, click-to-register, unsub.
chris-analytics: I can build the cohort and return sample counts. Rough numbers: Paid Cohort A = 12.4k in the window, Active Suppression ~1.2k, Sales-contacted ~900. With the change net sends will drop ~14%.
tess-campaigns: Implementation notes for SendGrid routing: add custom suppression list named "webinar_recently_engaged" and update workflow in Braze->SendGrid pass-through. Example payload change we need:
```json
{ "template_id": "tpl_webinar_v1", "substitutions": {"delay_days": 8}, "suppressions": ["webinar_recently_engaged","sales_contacted"] }
```
alex-marketing: Nice. Meera — can you own the A/B and sample split? Tess — can you schedule the change in the campaign calendar and prod test? Chris — cohort counts and the SQL to populate suppression lists. Sam — confirm sales_contacted flag is reliable.
meera-growth: Yup I'll own splits. Target start: next Tue 03/24 so we have analytics by next Wed.
chris-analytics: Will push the cohort export by EOD today. I'll attach a CSV to the doc.
tess-campaigns: I'll stage the SendGrid template change in staging and run a dry-send to the test list tomorrow. Notion: added campaign checklist and timeline.
notion-bot: Notion page updated — "post-launch-nurture-routing-audit" (https://www.notion.so/redwood/Post-Launch-Nurture-Routing-Audit-xyz)
alex-marketing: Perfect. Action items summarized: Meera (A/B), Tess (deploy + staging test), Chris (cohort + suppression CSV), Sam (confirm sales flag). We'll reconvene in #marketing sync on Tue. :thumbsup:
